text: FCLoopCreateRulesToGLI[topo] creates replacement rules for converting numerators from the given topology to GLI objects with inverse propagators.
It is also possible to use FCLoopCreateRulesToGLI[{topo1, topo2, ...}].
FCLoopCreateRulesToGLI[FCTopology[topo1, {SFAD[{p1, m1^2}], SFAD[{p2, m2^2}], SFAD[{p1 - p2, m3^2}]}, {p1, p2}, {}, {}, {}]]
FCLoopCreateRulesToGLI[FCTopology["prop2Lv1", {SFAD[{p1, m1^2}], SFAD[{p2, m2^2}], SFAD[p1 - q], SFAD[p2 - q], SFAD[{p1 - p2, m3^2}]}, {p1, p2}, {Q}, {}, {}]]

topoList = { FCTopology["prop3Lv1", {SFAD[p1], SFAD[p2], SFAD[p3], SFAD[p1 - p2], SFAD[p2 - p3], SFAD[p1 + q1], SFAD[p2 + q1], SFAD[p3 + q1], SFAD[{{0, p1 . p3}}]}, {p1, p2, p3}, {q1}, {}, {}], FCTopology["prop3L2", {SFAD[p1], SFAD[p2], SFAD[p3], SFAD[p1 - p2], SFAD[p2 - p3], SFAD[p1 - p3], SFAD[p1 + q1], SFAD[p3 + q1], SFAD[{{0, (p1 - p2) . q1}}]}, {p1, p2, p3}, {q1}, {}, {}], FCTopology["prop3L3", {SFAD[p1], SFAD[p1 - p4], SFAD[p3], SFAD[p4], SFAD[p1 - p3 - p4], SFAD[p1 + q1], SFAD[p3 + p4 + q1], SFAD[p3 + q1], SFAD[{{0, (p4) . q1}}]}, {p1, p3, p4}, {q1}, {}, {}] }
